full_prompt_en: A square documentary photograph shows an enormous black-and-white animal skull mural painted across the side of an old brick building above a row of parked cars. The building fills most of the frame, its weathered tan-brown wall rising to an uneven roofline with several short chimney stacks. At the left, a narrower facade with repeated windows gives the street corner a vertical edge. The mural dominates the center and right of the wall: a broad elongated skull points toward the left, with a long snout, a large empty eye socket, and bared lower teeth. Deep charcoal strokes model the hollows under the brow and within the jaw, while pale gray highlights follow the rounded bone surfaces. Dense scratchy linework and layered shading give the skull a rough, almost fur-like texture where the form fades at the rear. The creature's muzzle projects visually from the wall toward the street, yet brick joints and patches of old plaster remain visible through or around the image. Along the bottom edge, dark blue, gray, and black cars park nose to tail; their small scale emphasizes the mural's vast size. The pavement is narrow and plain, with no prominent pedestrians. A pale overcast sky appears above the roof and keeps the wall evenly lit without dramatic cast shadows. The camera looks across the street from near car height, making the skull span almost the full side elevation. The photograph retains real wall stains, old windows, and urban wear, while the painted subject supplies the strongest contrast and detail. No mural wording is readable. The overall composition is startling and matter-of-fact, setting a highly rendered monochrome creature against ordinary aging architecture and everyday vehicles.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形纪实照片呈现一幅巨大的黑白动物头骨壁画，横跨旧砖楼侧面，下面停着一排汽车。建筑填满大部分画框，受风化的黄棕色墙面升到不齐屋顶线，上面有几根短烟囱。左侧较窄的立面以重复窗户为街角划出竖边。壁画支配墙面中央和右侧：一只宽大细长的头骨朝左，带长口鼻、大而空的眼窝和露出的下排牙齿。深炭色笔痕塑造眉下与颚内凹洞，浅灰高光沿圆转骨面行走。密集刮擦般线条与层叠阴影使头骨带粗糙、近似毛皮的纹理，尤其在后部形体渐隐处。动物吻部在视觉上从墙面朝街道伸出，但砖缝和旧灰泥斑块仍透过或围绕图像可见。沿底缘，深蓝、灰与黑色汽车首尾相接停放；小小的尺度强调壁画的巨大。铺地狭窄而朴素，没有显眼行人。浅阴天天空露在屋顶上方，让墙面均匀受光，没有戏剧性投影。相机从接近车高的街对面观看，使头骨几乎跨满整面侧立面。照片保留真实墙污、旧窗和城市磨损，绘制主体提供最强对比与细节。壁画上没有可读文字。整体构图惊人却平实，让精细刻画的单色生物形象置于寻常老建筑和日常车辆之上。
style_prompt_en: The mural style enlarges a monochrome biological form until it dominates an existing textured surface. Charcoal-black hatching and pale gray highlights build convincing volume, while rough edges let the image merge into weathered material. The underlying substrate remains visible, adding cracks, seams, stains, and color variation that no smooth canvas could supply. One strong silhouette is organized around a few deep voids, so the image reads from far away despite intricate internal linework. Natural overcast light keeps paint and wall in the same tonal world. Scale contrast between the oversized image and small ordinary surroundings heightens impact without extra color. The overall effect is raw and monumental, combining detailed draftsmanship with the physical history of an outdoor surface.
style_prompt_zh: 这种壁画风格把一个单色生物形体放大到支配现成肌理表面。炭黑排线与浅灰高光建立可信体积，粗边又让图像融入风化材料。底层载体仍可见，为画面增加裂缝、接缝、污迹和色差，这是光滑画布无法提供的。一个有力剪影围绕少数深洞组织，因此内部线条虽繁复，从远处仍能读清。自然阴天光使颜料与墙面处在同一调性世界。超大图像与周围普通小物的尺度对比无需额外颜色就提高冲击力。整体效果粗粝而宏伟，把精细素描能力与户外表面的实体历史结合。
theme_en: A giant black-and-white animal skull mural across an old brick building
theme_zh: 一幅巨大的黑白动物头骨壁画横跨旧砖楼立面
name: ROA
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
